name: Up With Doznik
storyline:
The Universe was so bored with spheres, sooo last terayear of a shape, *rings* are IN! It plotted and schemed then the Chaine was born, where six rings came together to form a stunning galaxy.

After a rather hard fall, you find yourself on an unfamiliar ring. The dwarf, Doznik, helps you get on your feet, and demands you protect him on the road to the castle—a road conveniently packed with shapeshifting monsters who probably aren't interested in a friendly chat.

Arm yourself with whatever scrap of weaponry you can find (mostly sticks, cheese, and sheer willpower) and brew the most vile potions the rings of Chaine have ever seen. Experiment with different builds and upgrade your arsenal with every run.
summary: A failed accountant finds himself on an unfamiliar ring. Rescued by a dwarf, they head for the castle, equipped with a mildly menacing stick, questionable potions, and a dream. Fight shapeshifting monsters, upgrade, die, repeat—and grow stronger each time.
